name: What are the typical phases of finishing an unfinished basement?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical phases of finishing an unfinished basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A basement renovation begins with space planning, followed by rough framing, mechanical rough-ins, inspections, insulation, drywall, and finish work. First, we outline your floor plan and frame interior partition walls. Next, licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades run rough-in lines through the framing. Once mechanical inspections pass, our in-house team installs insulation, hangs and finishes drywall, lays tile or specialty flooring, and installs custom doors, molding, and interior paint. Finally, light fixtures, plumbing trim, and hardware are installed for the final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves through framing, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall installation, trim carpentry, tile, and interior painting before final fixtures are installed.
